mapper.select: SELECT * FROM announcements WHERE status = 1 AND is_pinned = 1 ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO announcements (admin_id, title, content, type, status, priority, likes_count, is_pinned, publish_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{type}, #{status}, #{priority}, 0, 0, #{publishAt}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE announcements SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, type = #{type}, status = #{status}, priority = #{priority}, publish_at = #{publishAt}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE announcements SET likes_count = COALESCE(likes_count, 0) + #{delta} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE announcements SET is_pinned = #{isPinned}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
